subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the stale-completion race is fixed, should this branch become the canonical Mattermost thread-recovery implementation instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243, with a 10-second maximum one-attempt-per-session lookup?
rationale: The permanent timeout, no-retry policy, and choice between overlapping implementations affect user-visible reply latency and session recovery behavior, so repository history cannot safely choose them automatically.

options.title: Adopt this PR after repair
options.body: Prefer its bounded response, marker lifecycle, and concurrent-turn design after stale recovery writes are rejected.

options.title: Adopt the competing PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 if its smaller timeout-oriented design is the desired permanent policy.

options.title: Reject inbound backfill
options.body: Close both implementations if awaiting Mattermost during a cold inbound turn is not an acceptable channel-runtime tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR after repair
recommendation.body: Prefer its bounded response, marker lifecycle, and concurrent-turn design after stale recovery writes are rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Mattermost threading work is the closest feature-history ownership signal for this policy choice.
